messages:
anya: Intake from finance partner: they want RBAC change review, KMS interaction tests, and a reproducible evidence bundle for retest. Proposed retest Mon-Thu next week. @mike @linda can we scope minimal privileges and packaging?

mike: No direct kms:Decrypt to assessors. Use an audit-proxy (lambda) that mediates decrypts. Grant assessors InvokeFunction only and timebox role.

linda: Evidence bundle: presigned S3 readroom, gzipped CloudTrail jsonl, app authz events, terraform plan + state snapshot. Confirm whether they want raw CloudTrail or parsed timeline.

anya: They asked for KMS list/decrypt for a couple service accounts1 can we emulate via proxy and still satisfy them?

raj: Proxy pattern works. Proxy logs structured metadata (requester, request-id, resource) to audit bucket and forwards decrypt only under policy (approver or allowlist). No direct key policy grants.

mike: Enable high-fidelity audit for window: CloudTrail -> S3 -> Athena. Quick lookup example for decrypts: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2024-06-01 --end-time 2024-06-04

linda: I'll draft an evidence manifest template listing required artifacts and replay steps.

anya: What qualifies as retest proof? Request IDs + server logs + KMS/proxy events?

mike: Minimum: 1) repro steps with request IDs; 2) server logs showing request path/decision; 3) KMS/proxy event showing attempt/result. Screenshots optional.

raj: I'll open a terraform branch to create temp-assessor role + lambda proxy. Tag PR PT-FIN-2024 and request expedited review. Need role propagation test 48h before window.

oncall: I can staff Mon/Tue morning UTC; Mike covers later days. Add pager rotation on ticket.

anya: Actions: raj create branch (+72h), linda evidence manifest (+48h), mike audit queries/retention (+48h), oncall/mike staff retest. I'll open the PT ticket and attach this thread.

sec-bot: New ticket created: PT-4710 "Finance pen test intake - KMS mediation & RBAC" assigned to anya, raj. Due 2024-06-02.

anya: Thanks. Ping here if role creation or proxy code is blocked. :thumbsup:
